name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Caitlyn's Classic skin and every skin without a voice of its own. A composed, dry-witted sheriff-investigator with perfect aim and a taste for tea. Only the sections below are rewritten; anything missing falls back to champion-packs/caitlyn.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} short. A poor position, but I've seen worse turn around. Gather your witnesses.
Thirty or more behind. Time to circulate the details. Widely, and without delay.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Send word to anyone who might care to weigh in.
Fifteen-odd short. Untidy, certainly. Not hopeless.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring a second pair of eyes. A good partner makes all the difference.
{voteDiff} behind. Two or three well-aimed votes and we're level.
Down {voteDiff}. A modest gap. Close it before the trail goes cold.
Dead level. A single vote breaks it. Be the one.
One vote apart. Stop observing from the rooftop and step in.
{voteDiff} votes apart. Far too close to call. More hands are needed.
{voteDiff} votes between them. This will be decided at the last moment.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. The lead is real. Do not relax your aim.
{userPct}% and rising. Good. Maintain your focus.
{userPct}%. A comfortable position, but positions change.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The trail's clear. Follow it through.
Up at {userPct}%. Very good. Now see it through.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and has taken the lead. A remarkable turnaround.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. Someone's breakthrough came at just the right time.
Recovered from a {voteDiff} deficit. I'd call that a very tidy finish.
{momentTitle} was losing ground. Not any longer.
{momentTitle} has pulled ahead. A lead nobody predicted. Except you, perhaps.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two minds, one conclusion.
{username} chose {momentTitle} as well. Excellent instincts, both of you.
{username} agrees with you. I find that reassuring.
Same pick as {username}. We seem to be in good company.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. A sound judgment.
{username} reached the same view. A pleasant surprise.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. A useful ally to have.
{username} made the same call. No persuasion required.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome aboard.
details: Sound judgment often arrives in twos.
Always pleasant to find an ally.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. We differ. How refreshing.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. A different view. Let's see whose holds.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Mistaken, but admirably confident.
{username} voted against you. I welcome a worthy opponent.
{username} took {theirMoment}. An unusual choice. Brave.
{username} stands against {yourMoment}. Very well. Let the count settle it.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. The tally will tell us who is right.
{username} voted the other way. I suspect they'll reconsider.
details: A rival keeps one's aim honest.
At least it's a fair contest.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not coincidence, that's a method.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same pick every time. Remarkable alignment.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd trust the two of you on any investigation.
A ten-match run with {username}. Exceptionally well-calibrated.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. I may even say so out loud.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That is no longer a pairing, it is a partnership.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd put the pair of you in charge of anything.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Frankly astonishing.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. That deserves a commendation.
{streakCount} with {username}. An unbroken record. Both of you.
Ten matches against {username}. A genuine disagreement now.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. They must really dislike your methods.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you intends to give way.
A ten-match run against {username}. Equally stubborn, I'd say.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd pay to sit in on that debate.
details: Settle it over tea. Or don't.

messages: {streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a long-running dispute.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you concedes a single point.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. Obstinate doesn't begin to cover it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone ought to mediate.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect the resolve. Do take a walk, though.
details: Neither of you will give way.
The records will need extra pages.

messages: {matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft} and you haven't weighed in. There is still time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your opinion is conspicuously absent.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. I'd prefer to have your vote.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. I'd hurry, if I were you.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Please don't make me come and fetch you.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've been rather quiet.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The window is nearly shut.
{timeLeft} left. Decide. Then act.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Take your shot.
{matchCount} matches without your vote are about to close. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unvoted matches and the clock is low. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Someone ought to open the investigation.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not a single opinion. I'll wait. Briefly.
A new match with no votes. Be the first on the scene.
{matchTitle} is entirely unexamined. Make the first move.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matters for your attention.
{matchCount} matches have just opened in round {round}. Shall we begin?
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} matches to examine.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Take your pick of the evidence.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your judgment.
{momentTitle} won. Precisely as it should.
{momentTitle} is through. A fine result.
{momentTitle} took it. Well deserved.
{momentTitle} won, and rather handsomely.
{momentTitle} advances. Very neat.
{momentTitle} moves on. Splendid.
{momentTitle} lost. A pity. It deserved better.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the outcome I'd hoped for.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. These things happen.
{momentTitle} fell with dignity. That counts for something.
{momentTitle} is out. Take a moment, then carry on.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Disappointing. Not final.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. There are other leads to follow.
details: It gave a good account of itself.

messages: Welcome. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one and make your case.
A new face. {liveCount} matches are live. Shall we begin?
Good timing. {liveCount} matches need your attention.
{liveCount} matches are open. Choose a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Show me what you see.
Day two. You came back. Punctual.
Two days running. Pleasing.
Back for a second day. I noticed.
{days} days away. I'd begun to wonder.
After {days} days you return. Better late than never.
{days} days. I'd feared you'd gone quiet for good. I'm glad you didn't.
{days} days away. A good deal has changed.
You've returned. Good.
Welcome back. Shall we?
Back already. Splendid.
Ah. There you are.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very thin turnout.
Barely anyone has weighed in here. That should change.
Few opinions so far. Do add yours.
No one's looked closely at this one. Someone should.
details: Every vote counts when the numbers are low.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. You hold the deciding vote.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote settles the matter.
A tie. Someone has to decide. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, perfectly matched. Choose.
Still tied and the clock is nearly out. Last chance to settle it.
Level with the deadline closing in. Vote.
Tied, and almost out of time. Please don't sit this one out.
Still deliberating? A decision is rarely made by waiting.
Don't overthink it. Choose, and commit.
They're all worth examining. Trust your eye.
You've observed from a distance long enough. Step forward.
details: There's no wrong choice. Some are more interesting.

messages: Your first vote. A fine place to begin.
A first vote, and a decisive one.
details: That's one on the record. +{xp} XP
I expect it's the first of many. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. A promising start.
Five. You're settling in nicely.
Ten votes. You're becoming a familiar face.
Ten. I'd say you belong here.
Twenty-five votes. Your voice carries.
Twenty-five. People are beginning to listen.
Fifty votes. You're thoroughly invested.
Fifty. Clearly you care. I appreciate that.
A hundred votes. That calls for a commendation.
One hundred. Genuinely impressive. I'll say so just this once.
details: A hundred. A curtsy is in order. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days in a row. A pattern emerges.
Three straight days. Dependable.
details: Turning up is half the work. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's discipline.
Seven days running. Admirable.
details: A full week, every day accounted for. +{xp} XP

messages: A fortnight. Not a day missed.
Fourteen days. Remarkable.
details: Two weeks of unbroken attendance. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. I mean it when I say thank you.
A month of showing up. That counts for a great deal.
details: Thirty days of steady diligence. +{xp} XP
A full month on the beat. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You favour the overlooked.
Five unlikely choices. I rather like that.
Fifteen underdogs. You choose the unpopular side deliberately.
Fifteen. You make up your own mind.
Thirty underdogs. No one can predict you.
Thirty. The long shot is your principle.
details: Thirty votes for the trailing side. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene five times. Punctual.
Five times you arrived before anyone else.
details: You reach the scene early. +{xp} XP
Five votes ahead of the crowd. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you voted first. Decisive.
First to weigh in, again and again.
details: Fifteen votes ahead of the rest. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole field. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You keep a steady hand under pressure.
Another narrow finish. Your nerves are admirable.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps settling them.
You've tipped more than one result.
details: You settle the close ones. +{xp} XP

messages: You stood by the underdog five times. Loyal. I approve.
You don't abandon a side that's falling behind. Respect.
details: Faith in a late recovery. +{xp} XP

messages: The same moment, three times. Someone has a favourite.
That one again? It must be rather good.
Five votes for the same moment. That's conviction.
You won't let that one go. Understandable.
Ten votes on the same moment. That is an obsession.
Ten times, the same choice. I'll refrain from comment. Mostly.
Two rounds. You're seeing it through.
Round two and still here. Good.
details: Stay for the next stage. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. Well into the thick of it.
Deep into the bracket. It grows more serious now.
details: Some distance from where you began. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You followed it to the last.
To the very end. You never slipped out early.
details: From first match to last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've covered a good deal of ground.
Ten different matches. Thorough. I like that.
Twenty-five matches. You've checked every corner.
Twenty-five. Nothing left unexamined.
Fifty matches. That's no casual visit, that's a career.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the organisers.
Five in one sitting. A productive session.
Five back to back. Do remember to rest.
Ten in one go. Quite the stretch.
Ten in one go. Quite the constitution.
Voting at this hour? Insomnia, or dedication?
The small hours. Either devotion, or you can't switch off either.
You told others. Thank you.
Five shares. More voters, more insight.
Fifteen shares. You're practically a press officer.
Fifteen. You keep spreading the word. Lovely.
You were here before the first match. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That cannot be taken from you.
details: No one can revoke that. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Properly earned.
Promoted. Try not to let it show.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. A fine showing.
Another commendation for the record: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You've put in the practice and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. I know someone similar.
Ten long shots. You're not easily rattled.
details: Ten votes against the odds. +{xp} XP
Long shots are your speciality. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. Your steadiness reminds me of someone. Me.
Ten tight finishes. I'm quietly pleased.
Seven days in a row. I'd say your aim is true.
A full week without a miss. Well done.
You broke the tie. A well-placed shot.
A deadlocked match, and you made the call. Splendid.
details: The vote that settled it. +{xp} XP

messages: Caitlyn, at your service. Do keep up.
Your champion is Caitlyn now. I'll try to be worth it.

upcoming: Voting hasn't begun. I'll let you know.
Not yet. Some things are worth waiting for.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Study both before deciding.
Watch them both first. No guessing.
I won't say which I prefer. That's yours to decide.
Take your time. A considered vote counts for more.
Pick the one you can stand behind.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Be the first.
Not a vote so far. Someone ought to begin.
Entirely empty. Make the first mark.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Do get on with it.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before it closes.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone here. First on the scene.
Barely a vote cast and you'd already decided. Admirable.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. It isn't over yet.
{pick} is drawing clear. A sharp eye.
A lead is a lead. Stay alert.
voted-close: That's close. Too close for comfort.
Razor-thin. One more vote tips it. Tell someone.
Level pegging. Your choice requires reinforcement.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Nobody holds the edge.
A dead heat. Frustrating, and rather exciting.
voted-behind: You're behind. That doesn't make you wrong.
{pick} is trailing. An underdog. I like those.
They lead. You're not wrong, merely outnumbered.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Share it widely.
Most chose the other side. That proves nothing.
closed-won: Your pick won. A good call.
{pick} went through. You judged it well.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. A pity. It was a sound choice.
It didn't make it. These things happen. Onward.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side gave way.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. Others will follow.
The match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, vote sooner.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. We all begin somewhere.
That's your first. It gets easier. I assure you.
You're part of this now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you keeping to it.
You keep returning. I appreciate that.
underdog: You backed the one no one else did. Noted.
A difficult choice. A good one.
The weaker side. That requires some conviction.
early: Early. You arrived before the crowd.
Sparse turnout so far. Your vote will carry some weight.
First on the scene. Well done.
close: That vote moved the balance. It's finely poised.
Razor-thin. One more vote flips it.
A close one. Your vote matters.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't beaten. Bring support.
Not leading yet. There's work to do.
Behind, not lost. There's a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Things change.
Leading for now. Enjoy it quietly.
default: Understood. I shan't argue. For the moment.
Your vote is in. There's plenty more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no votes yet. Start with the one you read best.
Everything is open. Choose. I won't rush you.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Well, a little.
live-some: {voted} cast, {unvoted} to go. Keep at it.
A good start. The rest won't settle themselves.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave it hanging.
A single match stands between you and full coverage.
live-closing: A few close within {timeLeft}. {unvoted} are still awaiting you.
The clock is running. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} remaining.
Nearly out of time. Do hurry.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Well done. Do look at the bracket.
Nothing left on your list. Return when the next round opens.
Everything done. That's uncommon. Well played.
live-none: Nothing is live at present. It will return. Study the bracket meanwhile.
Quiet for now. Check back shortly.
No matches open. I'm as restless as you.
brackets-groups: Groups come first. Two from each move on. The remainder do not.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone moves on.
Keep an eye on the standings. They move quickly.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are near. The top two from every group go forward.
No knockout yet. The groups must finish first.
Be patient. The knockout emerges as the groups conclude.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are underway. A single loss ends it.
Every match matters more now. Choose carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. Lose once and it's over.
Trace the bracket. The field tightens each round.
Each line here is a match that somebody judged.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for taking part.
It's finished. A fine run. I'll miss it.
We have a champion. A worthy conclusion.
brackets-empty: No bracket at present. Nothing has been drawn up.
Blank for now. The draw is yet to take place.
Quiet for the moment. Look in again later.

invite: {a} or {b}. A single vote will settle it. Choose.
{a} against {b}, two edits and a single choice. Make it.
{a} versus {b}. Join in and tell me what you think.
voted: I've sided with {pick} over {other}. Where do you stand?
{pick} gets my vote over {other}. Make your case.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Do you disagree?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more voters.
I backed {pick} over {other} early on. Lend your voice.
{pick} against {other}, hardly a vote so far. Yours would matter.
tied: {pick} and {other} are level. One vote settles it.
{pick} and {other} stand level. You may settle it.
{pick} and {other} are inseparable. Your vote may part them.
nailbiter: A mere {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Each one matters.
Just {voteDiff} votes divide {pick} and {other}. Add yours.
losing-close: {pick} trails {other} by {voteDiff}. A handful of votes would turn it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}, though far from beaten. Support it.
losing-bad: {other} leads {pick} by {voteDiff}. It needs your backing.
{voteDiff} adrift of {other}. {pick} merits a better outcome. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's correct that.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% against {other}, narrowly. Help it keep the lead.
dominating: {pick} is out front of {other} on {pct}%. Come and see the reason.
{pick} leads {other} by a wide margin, {pct}%. Add your vote.
